The '''VL-22 Plasma Core Rifle''' was a model of plasma [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The VL-22 Plasma Core Rifle was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Wild Space Explorer's Pack, which was released to the Cartel Market on [[September 1]], [[2015]].<ref name="TOR" />
